verses.sayyidu-l-hurufi-c1-v1: lā kamā qālati l-qaṣāʾidu ʾanta ʾanta fawqa lladhī yuqālu nkashafta
verses.sayyidu-l-hurufi-c1-v2: ʾanta yā sayyida l-ḥurūfi jamīʿā kayfa lil-ḥarfi ʾan yaʿī mā ḥtawayta
verses.sayyidu-l-hurufi-c1-v3: ʾanta sirru yaṭūfu kullu l-maʿānī ḥawlahu, qul fī ʾayyī maʿnā sarayta
verses.sayyidu-l-hurufi-c1-v4: qīla lī ʾanna qalbaka s-samḥa ʾabhā min jalāli l-ʾashyāʾa yawma ṭalaʿta
verses.sayyidu-l-hurufi-c1-v5: qīla lī ʾanna ṣamtaka l-mushtahā mā zāla ʾarqā mina l-kalāmi waʾaftā
verses.sayyidu-l-hurufi-c1-v6: futinat ʾarwāḥu l-muḥibbīna lammā ḥāshidā bis-samāʾi jiʾita wabuḥta
verses.sayyidu-l-hurufi-c1-v7: kayfa lā tahwāka l-qulūbu wafīkum muzija ṭ-ṭuhru bil-jamāli faluḥta
verses.sayyidu-l-hurufi-c1-v8: bika yaṣfū l-maʿnā falaw ʾanna yawmā qīla lil-ḥubbi mā ṣ-ṣafā? qāla: ʾanta
verses.sayyidu-l-hurufi-c1-v9: law ḥakā d-dahru waz-zamānu laqālā l-ḥikmahu l-ʾāna ʾaynaʿat mundhu jiʾita
verses.sayyidu-l-hurufi-c1-v10: ʾāna lid-dunyā - sayyidī - ʾan tudāwā bika ʾaḥzānuhā waʾanta staṭaʿta
